thread:
marta: quick flag 66u0034 5 — gemma-lite-int8 on the long-context summarization bench is hallucinating facts (invented dates/places) vs fp16 baseline. repro rate ~12% on news-long-1k.
oliver: hm. hallucinations after quant often point to attention weight distortion or rotary mishandling. did you check k/v cosine similarity between fp16 and int8?
marta: yes. small script below. cos_sim drops on later steps (t>250).
```
# compare kv norms
for t in range(0, seq_len, 50):
    cos = cos_sim(kv_fp16[t], kv_int8[t])
    print(t, cos)
# output: 0 0.99, 250 0.72, 500 0.61
```

sam: that decay suggests accumulation error, maybe rotary phase scaling per-head was collapsed during the export (shared scalar used instead of headwise). Gemma variants expect headwise scaling.
marta: checked the exported config.json: "rotary_scale": 1.0 (single), model config pre-export has "rotary_scale_per_head": true. exporter reduced it.
nina: why would exporter collapse to single scalar? any code path that fuses per-head params into a shared tensor for int8 packing?
marta: found in `export/pack_quant.py` a path `if use_fast_pack: pack_scalar(rotary_scale)` which assumes scalar. unit tests didn't catch because earlier models had shared scale.

sam: two quick mitigations:
1) re-export with per-head scale preserved (slow pack) and rerun int8 calibration
2) add an adapter layer at load that broadcasts headwise scale from the tokenizer/model manifest if missing

oliver: also run a token-normalization diff. We had a case where lowercase normalization merged tokens around dates and the model's positional expectation shifted, worsening long-span correlations. Might be orthogonal but worth validating.
marta: ran token-norm diff: fp16 tokenizer normalizes NFKC+lowercase, int8 path was using exported tokenizer without lowercase flag due to `freeze_tokenizer=True` in the pipeline. mismatch on ~0.5% tokens in dataset (mostly named entities).
sam: that could amplify hallucinations when attention patterns break. Fix plan: preserve tokenizer flags in export and add an integration test comparing tokenization hashes for the calib set.

marta: repro plan:
- re-export gemma-lite with per-head rotary_scale preserved
- run int8 pack & calibrate on calib-news-long-5k
- run longbench and collect: hallucination_rate, fact_precision, kv_cos_sim(time buckets)

ci-bot: queued job pack-9221 for re-export (node: ded12).
eval-bot: baseline metrics for fp16 -> hallucination_rate 2.1%, fact_precision 0.86 (news-long-1k). current int8: hallucination_rate 12.3%, fact_precision 0.62.
marta: small experimental patch in PR `GH:pr/4599` — toggles `use_fast_pack=False` and preserves `rotary_scale_per_head`. Running locally quick calibrate shows kv_cos_sim(500) improves from 0.61 -> 0.93 and hallucination down to ~3.8% in smoke run.
oliver: great. please add a regression test in `tests/onboard/test_tokenizer_and_rotary.py` that fails when per-head flags are lost and assert kv_cos_sim > 0.9 at t=500 for the first 10 samples.

sam: long-term, exporter should validate model.config vs export.manifest and fail CI if special per-head params are collapsed. Add a checksum guard for rotary shapes.
marta: adding tests + manifest guard to PR. also updating release notes: "preserve per-head rotary scaling for gemma-family models during quant pack".

nina: can we add short canary in Dedicated: route `gemma-lite:int8-rotary-preserve` at 2% with telemetry: hallucination_rate, kv_cos_sim_buckets, avg_tokens? Better to be safe.
marta: will request canary after PR merges. thanks all. :rocket:
